question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ENTIRE
solution:
The correct answer is "**Partial**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the word:
 
• **Entire**: with no part left out; whole.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options:
 
• **Equal**: being the same in quantity, size, degree, or value.
 
• **Partial**: existing only in part; inco
